content_en.prompt: A tower is called special if all towers to its left are smaller and all towers to its right are larger.
content_en.question: How many towers in the picture are special?
content_en.explanation: Five towers satisfy the condition, as can be verified by checking each tower against all towers to its left and right.
content_en.ct_explanation: This task is central to Quicksort, a fast, common sorting algorithm. A tower where everything left is smaller and everything right is larger is called a pivot element — it divides the array into two smaller sub-arrays, which are sorted recursively ("divide & conquer"). This is why Quicksort is faster than many other sorting algorithms: roughly log₂(n) levels of partitioning are needed for n elements.

content_zh.prompt: 如果一座塔左邊所有的塔都比它矮、右邊所有的塔都比它高，這座塔就叫做「特殊塔」。
content_zh.question: 圖中總共有幾座特殊塔？
content_zh.explanation: 共有5座塔符合條件，逐一檢查每座塔的左邊和右邊就可以確認。
content_zh.ct_explanation: 這一題正好是「快速排序法」(Quicksort)的核心概念：左邊都比較小、右邊都比較大的元素叫做「基準元素」(pivot)，它可以把陣列切成兩個較小的子陣列，再遞迴地分別排序，這種方法叫做「分治法」(divide & conquer)。這正是快速排序比許多其他排序演算法更快的原因：n個元素大約只需要log₂(n)層切分。
